<h2>Run an Issue 138 Representative Validation</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Runs staged tuning and selected final targets for one bounded validation
profile through the shared sjSDM orchestration engine.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_issue138_representative_validation(
  active_config = NULL,
  unit_pipeline = NULL,
  tuning_target_names = NULL,
  final_target_names = NULL,
  store_suffix = NULL,
  prebuild_interpolation = FALSE,
  fresh_run = TRUE,
  run_sequence_function = run_sjsdm_tuning_sequence,
  run_pipeline_function = run_pipeline
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="active_config">active_config</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-default configuration profile used for the validation.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="unit_pipeline">unit_pipeline</code></td>
<td>
<p>Unit pipeline script passed to [run_sjsdm_tuning_sequence()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="tuning_target_names">tuning_target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Public v2 tuning-artifact targets included in the validation.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="final_target_names">final_target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Final model and v2 evaluation-artifact targets to complete.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="store_suffix">store_suffix</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional isolated spatial-unit store suffix.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prebuild_interpolation">prebuild_interpolation</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical controlling the first-round interpolation prebuild.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fresh_run">fresh_run</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical controlling whether the first tuning round clears its isolated
target store. Use 'FALSE' to resume completed work items.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="run_sequence_function">run_sequence_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable tuning-sequence function used by tests.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="run_pipeline_function">run_pipeline_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable pipeline runner used by tests.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'NULL'. Results are written to isolated target stores.
</p>
